name: Z-order Curve Flattening
definition: A flattening function that converts 3D voxel coordinates to a 1D index, placing voxels nearby in space nearby in memory to improve GPU cache locality.
summary: Z-order curve flattening maps 3D voxel coordinates to a 1D linear index via bit-interleaving, offering superior cache locality at a lower computational cost than Hilbert curves.
